title: WWW.DIYO.AI
description: Website design for DIYO.AI, a Nepal-based company developing speech and language AI for local contexts. The project focused on translating its technical work, products, achievements, and partnerships into a clear and accessible website, making the company’s work easier to understand and explore.

sections.title: Designing Beyond the Homepage
sections.body: I designed and organized the website’s supporting content, including individual bot pages, testimonials, awards, and partnerships. The focus was on giving each type of content a clear visual structure while keeping the overall experience consistent, easy to scan, and aligned with DIYO.AI’s identity.
